subject: planner, executor: make partition table generate `IndexReader` with `UnionScan` (#52337)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on planner/executor behavior. Change enables partition tables to use `IndexReader` under `UnionScan` by treating `model.ExtraPhysTblID` as index-covered, propagating it into `PhysicalIndexScan` schema, and decoding it from in-mem index keys in `memIndexReader`. Looked for correctness/transaction/locking/partition-ID propagation pitfalls and checked later upstream history for follow-up fixes; no remaining Blocker/High issues identified.
